text: Gold slipped about 0.4% to near $3,929 and silver about 1.7% to $49.66 as strong US job openings data lifted yields on election day.
Gold miners fell: GDX lost 1.96% to $77.60 and the 3x GDXU dropped 5.85% to $65.00.
The 10-year Treasury yield rose about 6 bp to near 4.96% by the close.
The Nasdaq rose 0.8% to 25,372 and the S&P 500 0.4% to 7,569 as chip stocks rebounded, while the Dow fell on Apple's slide; QQQ gained 0.62% and TQQQ 1.83%.
Brent settled down 1.1% at $103.60 after swinging more than $6 on reports of a US strike on Iran's Qeshm Island.
The dollar rose 0.46% to about 158.7 yen, inside the zone where traders watch for Japanese intervention.
After the close, Democrats scored early midterm wins: stock futures fell and Reuters reported gold up more than 2% to about $4,016 overnight.
